note: The decision each sales capability needs from the sales manager. Every row is awaiting her; none is confirmed. Types and rollback rules are defined in DECISION_QUEUE_FOR_ROSELEN.md.

decisions.decision: Confirm the abandoned-checkout table (paid former members and free Explorer sign-ups excluded) matches how you judge it by hand.
Confirm only Settled or Posted payments count as paid for reconciliation, as agreed with the program lead.
Should a billing finding that repeats every day keep appearing, or be held back after a set number of days?
When someone already paying is given a free seat, what happens to their paid plan?
Write down the analyst reporting you rely on today (which reports, how often, from where) so it can be taken over.
Confirm checkout links quote only the plan price of record ($149 a month billed annually, $199 monthly), never the retired $4,500.
Confirm the enrolment steps and name the owner of each (until then every step is unowned).
Set the fit-score pass mark and the warm-lead signals for prospect discovery.
Confirm you can open the approval page (/admin/approval-requests), and that you are the decider for each row of this matrix.
Who owns the advisory, custom build and enterprise offers, so a routed lead reaches a person?
What fit score qualifies a prospect, how many per batch and how often, and who approves each batch?
Should a sequence with no activity count as healthy, idle, or unknown?
What should happen when a payment is returned: a person reviews it, access is removed, or nothing?
When a customer id is found to belong to someone else, who should it go to?
Who should be told when the same payment notice arrives twice, and how fast?
Which figures do you want in your digest, in what order, how often and at what Central time?
Should a lead you move back by hand stay where you put it, even if an automatic email goes out?
Confirm the rule for which places count as live versus archived, so the price audit can be trusted to report clean.
Give the tone and brand rules for sales outreach, and say who sends which drafts.
Give the next cohort's dates (or who sets them) and check the example answers.
Which offers may a quote packet include, and who signs off the price on each?
Which of the three versions of the refund terms is final, and who signs it off?
Confirm the definition of 'needs attention' and the order you work the daily list in.
Should reminders stuck as 'claimed' (a send that may not have arrived) be reported?
Confirm the names Vick uses: 'collected (recorded)' and 'collected less refunds', with net revenue unavailable.
Confirm the revenue rules, including the proposed rules for refunds and time periods.
What seat count may be quoted to a prospect, and from which source?
How long after the start does a call count as missed, and should recovery emails start automatically?
When a cancellation skips PaySimple, who should be told: the member, a person, or both?
Confirm members are told billing starts the day they pay, not the class start date.
Which signals mark a member as at risk of not renewing (see the proposed payment-history signals)?
Are the team prices ($1,200 and $950 per seat a year) still right, and do sponsors name everyone up front?
